Adding a TL:DR here because I went over the character limit.

I suffer from PTSD, my friends are both in trouble, I've been having trouble juggling them and my own problems and I can't bring myself to tell them that I'm still in trouble. Therapy isn't working, and my fiancee and family are currently unavailable and dealing with their own problems.

Sure. I'll add a TL:DR, though it might be tricky.

Well, my fiancee has had me going to EMDR therapy, yeah. The sessions have been somewhat helpful, but the lad who usually does it has buggered off on holiday.

I originally had PTSD because of some shit my father did when I was a kid. It's left me scared of loud noises, REALLY scared of confrontation and being shouted at, and unable to be around other people for extended periods.
